summary: Phase 3H Reports close-out (F-57) retest, read-only (GET API calls + UI navigation only; theme switched with a DOM attribute so the profile was not written). 15 of 16 checks pass. Both iteration_52 HIGH issues are fixed: the Booking register live/cancelled links and the in-hand links now open v3 reports with the right filters. One new bug: the 'Refunds paid out' line on Collections for Feb 2026 opens an EMPTY Cancellations list. Outstanding and Customer status totals match, the PDF meets the spec, and the 390px mobile views have no overflow.

critical.issue: The line 'Refunds paid out −₹4,22,892' links to /reports/v3/cancellations?period_from=2026-02-01&period_to=2026-02-28. The Cancellations period filter uses cancelled_on, but BK-2526-3428 was cancelled 27 Jan 2026 and its refunds were paid 26 Feb 2026. The drill therefore shows '0 cancellations · period 01 Feb 2026 – 28 Feb 2026' and does not list the refund that was tapped. The same thing happens whenever a refund is paid in a later period than the cancellation.

minor.issue: Rows show the cheque's current State 'Cleared' and Days in hand 0. On 31 Oct those cheques were in hand for 1–2 days. The status and days do not describe the date chosen, which is confusing next to the headline 'in hand on 31 Oct 2026'.
The 'all time' value shows up in the UI as the chip 'PERIOD 01 Jan 2000 – —' and the headline '2 cancellations · period 01 Jan 2000 – -'. It would read better as 'All time' or without a period.

rca of the issue: Collections totals count refunds by refund-paid date (26 Feb 2026 for BK-2526-3428). _received_lines builds the drill link as '/reports/v3/cancellations?' + _period(p), which forwards period_from/period_to. The Cancellations v3 report applies its 'period' date_range filter to cancelled_on (27 Jan 2026), so the booking is filtered out. Reproduce: open /reports/v3/collections?period_from=2026-02-01&period_to=2026-02-28 and tap [data-testid=report-line-refunds] → '0 cancellations'. Fix: filter by refund paid date, or drop the period from the link.
